I had a suggestion to add a smart notification feature to remind the user for check-in after the vehicle crosses their pickup point. Sometimes, the vehicle arrives late or we miss by mistake to check-in, then we are marked as "No show" and it comes as a surprise. Introducing this one feature will help a lot for both transportation and end users. This may sound silly but even a small thing matters a lot.

Another bad thing is even though I am in 1 cab but I can see all the ones available for that time. I don't need to see others, just show me mine.

The GPS tracking system is very slow, and the pickup and drop timings are frequently incorrect. Additionally, the live location of other users is often not visible. Due to these issues, we are unable to determine the correct vehicle location, which is causing inconvenience. Kindly investigate and resolve these issues as soon as possible.

The GPS tracking system is often unreliable and sometimes shows the driver at an incorrect location, which can lead to unnecessary delays. In addition, the estimated arrival time displayed by the GPS tracker is frequently inaccurate, and the pickup time is rarely synchronized correctly. This has occasionally resulted in missed cab pickups. Notifications are also often delayed or, at times, not received at all, causing me to miss important updates regarding my ride.

The app frequently crashes or hangs while booking cabs, which makes it really frustrating, especially when I’m in a hurry. The GPS tracking is unreliable—it often shows the driver in the wrong location, causing unnecessary delays. Notifications are delayed or sometimes don’t come at all, so I end up missing important updates about my ride.

Content: There are a few suggestions which if done will make the app more user friendly: 1. If the cab arrangement is irrespective of number of bookings, and the same (approx ~20 seater) traveller comes everyday, then probably the feature of booking the cab atleast a week before can be eliminated. 2. Since the user is same everytime, the terms and conditions can be agreed and accepted at the first login. It is annoying when it pops up twice every single time the app is opened.

It's a great app to stay organised with office travel. However, if I want to change pickup/drop location, it doesn't allow me to do that without changing the shift timing. Update: for an app which has a very limited usecase, it is abysmally slow. Takes around 10-15 seconds to load even if I just have to check the OTP etc.

The app is astonishingly slow and is a pain to use. I cancelled a booking before a vehicle was alloted to me and it was reflected in the app but the next day, a driver was alloted to my "cancelled" trip. Edit: I couldn't contact any helpdesk either. There's a way to raise requests in the app but there's no way of knowing if the request has reached or is being worked upon. This is highly inconvenient.

app works fine. But... the app leaves a lot to be desired. yeah, it works fine but things like what to do when you're stuck...the error messages are confusing, you look around for settings and all but don't find information you need. You don't know if pressing anything will have an option to revert back....easily fixable and I think it will be.

As an employee, I appreciate the flexibility and convenience this app offers. The ability to add personalized pickup instructions would be great cause in my community they would not let a cab wait for 15 mins. I can specify exactly how I want my pickup to go down whether it's requesting the driver to arrive a certain number of minutes before my scheduled pickup time, calling me when they're a specific distance away, or even asking them to wait outside the street instead of coming inside.

It hasn't worked once since I installed. Trying to book a schedule keeps saying "there are no schedules available to book." I got a call directly from their sales/dev team who told that I need to buy a package first. The only way to do that is from within the app, which also never loads, failing with "Some error while fetching packages.." Sent them screenshots as requested. But finally they come up with "Sir it's a version issue because U have android 6." Ever heard of logging, MoveInSync team?
DeveloperReply:
Hi User,

We are sorry about your faced experience. We have already fixed this issue and will be releasing it very soon. Please mention your name and organisation name at app@moveinsync.com for further investigation. Kindly share your registered phone number so that we can call you up if we need more information.

Regards,
Pratyusha

Content: Very bad experience using this app. Most of the time doesn't work and gives error. Somehow if I was able to book the seat also, at the time of boarding the bus mostly doesn't open and I end up losing my booked seat. Content: The app isn't working since past 2 days. I am unable to book the cab. The screen is just loading. Please fix the issue asap. I logged out and logged in multiple times. And also installed and uninstalled the app. Unable to book the cab. I have to book the cab in next 4 hrs. Please fix it asap. It's been a week, I haven't received any reply. Hi,
Sorry about the inconvenience. Try clearing the cache or reinstalling the app. In case the issue still persists, kindly send the error screenshot to app@moveinsync.com along with the contact details so that we check this.

Content: Most frustrating aspect of this app is, when cab is waiting for you and you are in hurry, you will be logged out with no access to cab number/otp/call option to helpdesk etc. We do get regular SMS but what if we have to contact driver/help desk?? This is possible once when we can access the app!!! App team should be mindful about the frequency of logouts. I use multiple workplace apps like smartq, pluxee etc but non have this issue of suprise logouts that too when you are in hurry!!

The app does not let me book cab. It shows that there are no slots for that day but when I go to website and try to book the same, it works. Also, live tracking is completely unreliable. It ends up having an argument with the driver since when the cab driver is at my location, app shows that it is still 20-25 mins away.

it used send a push notification 30 mins before the scheduled logout, not getting that anymore. As ours is not shift based, we schedule our log out dynamically, and miss or forget the logout time scheduled if we are in middle of some work. Notification was always helpful to wrap up due to 30 mins headsup. Please enable it back!

The app is simply immature.. For e.g. it's hard to know what my current bookings are in a single view. More, a cancelled billing won't get off your screen. it stays there for eternity with a "cancelled"status. picking bulk dates is messy.. back and forward to select ... The UI is unintuitive and with no context help, it's pathetic UX. Updates: Change your mobile device, and find all your bookings gone !!!
DeveloperReply:
Hi Venky,

We are sorry to hear about your experience. We would like to investigate the issue and help you out accordingly, do share the screenshot of the screen. Kindly share your organisation name and employee id at app@moveinsync.com.

Thanks,
MIS Team

Content: They provide pickup and drop to the middle of nowhere from where its double work reaching our home or office from their stops. Very bad service. Today to pickup 3 people they send a 12 seater TT moreover the pickup was supposed to be at 11 the driver reached almost 40 minutes late. Most of the employees will avoid taking their services since it's so terrible. They're not ready to add more stops or improve the service. Also certain stops which are available during pickup disappear at drop booking

works well overall, but they don't listen to feedback. for example, pick ups from same apartment complex are scheduled with difference of upto 5 minutes. So, I come to the cab everyday, and wait 5 minutes for next passanger, and then another 5 minutes for the third passanger coming from same building. the third passanger can come upto 5 minutes late. so, I have waiting time of 10-15 minutes everyday just sitting in the cab. They don't care enough to fix it even after raising it 100s of times.

The app frequently shows errors, and the overall performance is not very smooth. There is definitely room for improvement. For example, when I try to book a schedule, the process often fails and the booking is not completed. Please look into this issue and improve the app's stability and performance.

overall a good app, but bring back seeing who all are traveling with you and their sequence number, also the app sometimes refuses to open and displays a message that says the app cannot be opened as it is not installed when it's clearly installed and i have to uninstall and reinstall and this has happened a few times so fix that bug

I love the service they are providing. worked with 2 organisations with this app, and has made my commute simplified, transition seamless and everything works perfectly. I honestly hate the ui, and it is unintuitive to change location and stuff. but I am still gonna rate 5 stats because I support their mission.

I am extremely frustrated with this app. Booking transport has become unnecessarily difficult because even when I carefully select specific dates, the system ends up creating bookings for completely different dates.To make matters worse, I was reported as a "No Show" despite having made a booking. What is even more confusing is that I then received a notification asking me to rate the trip, yet the system claims I never showed up. How does that make any sense?Fees will be deducted from my salary

This is a third class app which is not at all user friendly for employees, this is just made to the convenience of vendors,Help desk and vendors are not at all helpful on this app...they don't even consider your concerns.... worst transportation app I've ever used.

Hi Team, The MoveInSync app is forcing users to grant microphone access, even though it does not provide any direct in-app calling feature and all calls are routed through the regular phone dialer. Could you please clarify why microphone permission is mandatory? If it is not essential for the core functionality of the app, please stop forcing users to grant this permission and allow the app to function without it. Greater transparency around permission requirements would be appreciated.

good ... but it takes a lot of time to reload... & location is not accurate, little bit issues... & while opening application - every i have to accept the transport policies by clicking i agree... feel a little bit lag ,

Worst service I've ever experienced. I wish I could give 0 stars—they deserve -10000. My logout cab was scheduled for 6 PM. I waited for over 2 hours, calling customer support multiple times. They first told me to wait, then stopped answering my calls. Eventually, I had to walk home exhausted, hungry, and with a headache because no other cabs were available. To make it worse, they marked me as a "No Show," blaming me for their failure. Completely unacceptable.

does not let you book a bus if location accuracy is off. why do you need location accuracy? are you going to bring the bus to my house? well it does not even let you scan QR code now without location accuracy. thanks guys. any more ways you can make your app more useless?
app is good, just need one improvement, if it could send a notification in the morning as reminder on the day when I have booked the parking.

utter disaster, this app algorithm is worse, it took me 2.5 hr to reach my home to which I usually reach in 50 minutes if I take a long route. they have paired with people who belong to different areas. no one responded even after raising my concern.

New interface is better. Currently the only App shortcuts available are 'Create schedule' & 'Bus'. MoveInSync should allow QR code scanner as an App shortcut along with. Rather than going in to the app everytime, an App shortcut for QR code scanner makes things even better.

the cab was delay because of rain but please take only 3 passengers in a 4 seater cab, as it not comfortable to sit with 3 passengers on the back side, please add the 3 people in the cab, in this cab there were 3 people in the backsides and 1 person was huge in height body so it was very uncomfortable to sit with them.
